byjoba.com.title: byJoBa
byjoba.com.description: byJoBa stands for "by Jonas Barsten": the tools he makes in Oslo. Apps and services, extensions and tools for Ableton Live, and hardware.

jsonLd.name: byJoBa
jsonLd.description: byJoBa stands for "by Jonas Barsten": apps and services, music tools, and hardware.

projects.name: Jotufa
projects.summary: Invite-only event platform where the ticket is tied to the person.
projects.about: iOS, Android and web clients on a serverless AWS backend.

projects.name: Fiken MCP
projects.summary: MCP server that connects the Fiken accounting API to Claude and ChatGPT.
projects.about: Books receipts from a photo, sends invoices and answers questions about the accounts. Stores nothing on the server. MIT licensed.

projects.name: Fakfura
projects.about: Makes a PDF and hands it to the share sheet. In Norwegian. Runs in the browser.

projects.name: Fiken++
projects.summary: Chrome extension that adds one-click buttons to Fiken's bank reconciliation, starting with booking a transaction as private use.

projects.name: Lossless streaming (working title)
projects.summary: Web player for lossless audio from Dropbox, with playlists and every version of a track a click away.

projects.name: Oven Pa
projects.summary: iOS app for keeping a habit: a live timer since the last time, milestones, and what it has saved so far.

projects.name: Upload to Dropbox
projects.summary: Renders a selected clip and uploads it to Dropbox, as a new file or as a new version of an existing one.
projects.about: Uploads to any folder or creates one, and previews the audio files already there. Needs Ableton Live 12.4.5 or later.

projects.name: Upload to Samply
projects.summary: Renders a selected clip before effects and uploads it to Samply, as a new track or as a new version of an existing one.
projects.about: Uploads to any project or creates one, and previews the tracks already there. Needs Ableton Live 12.4.5 or later.

projects.name: Create X Tracks
projects.summary: Creates a batch of audio or MIDI tracks for multitrack recording, with inputs and outputs routed in sequence to the audio interface.
projects.about: Mono or stereo, with an optional name prefix. A review step shows each track's channels before anything is created.

projects.name: Track Export
projects.summary: Saves the selected Arrangement tracks as a new Live Set in the same project folder, leaving the original untouched.

projects.name: Set Location
projects.summary: Shows the file path of the Live Set that is open.

projects.name: Early Max for Live devices
projects.summary: Small devices and controller utilities shared for free: audio-trigg, CC-number-changer, key to MIDI, audio2midi, MIDI Relayer and others.

projects.name: Sordello
projects.summary: Subprojects for Ableton Live: a group track becomes its own set, and its bounce comes back.
projects.about: A macOS app and a Max for Live device.

projects.name: Cantica
projects.summary: Multitrack mixer and recorder for iPad and Mac.

projects.name: SMPTE Timecode Generator
projects.summary: macOS app that writes SMPTE LTC timecode as WAV files.

projects.name: Multitrack player (working title)
projects.summary: macOS app for live shows that plays hundreds of tracks from disk at once, with routing per track, cues and a waveform timeline.

projects.name: Kiwi
projects.summary: Headless instrument on a Raspberry Pi: piano, sampler and vocoder at once, blended with MIDI knobs.

projects.name: Vigil
projects.summary: Door access system: an ESP32 device with a maglock, a cloud API and apps.
projects.about: Grew out of a door lock prototype on Arduino with a keypad and display, made for OLYP in 2024.

projects.name: Minos
projects.summary: Networked MIDI routing for live rigs: a desktop routing matrix and PoE boxes with MIDI ports.
